children: Starry Sea postponed its Extraordinary General Meeting to Oct 19, 2026 and extended the redemption request deadline to Oct 15, 2026.
Extraordinary General Meeting moved from Oct 9 to Oct 19, 2026, now at 9:00 a.m. ET to allow more shareholder engagement.
No change to meeting location, record date (Sept 16, 2026), or proposals to be voted on at the meeting.
Redemption request deadline extended from Oct 7 to Oct 15, 2026; requests may be withdrawn before the new deadline.
Meeting remains at Torres & Zheng at Law, P.C. in New York and will be accessible via live webcast.
